# Quality Checklist

Use this checklist before finalizing frontend design work.

- Visual direction is explicit and easy to describe in one sentence.
- Typography scale is consistent across headings, body, labels, and captions.
- Color system is tokenized and not hardcoded ad hoc in many places.
- Spacing system is consistent; no random one-off spacing values.
- Background treatment adds atmosphere without harming readability.
- Motion is purposeful and limited; no noisy micro-animation overload.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior is respected.
- Mobile layout remains readable and usable at narrow widths.
- Desktop layout uses space intentionally; no stretched mobile leftovers.
- Focus states are visible and keyboard navigation remains usable.
- Contrast is acceptable for key text and interactive controls.
- Final output feels product-specific, not interchangeable template UI.
